## Description

Extracts orthogonal principal components (eigenportfolios) from a large equity universe covariance matrix, trading mean-reversion on the residual idiosyncratic components of non-market eigenportfolios.

## Where it may fit

Large stock index universes (S&P 500 / Russell 1000), sector-neutral market-neutral equity mandates.

## Vehicles

Quantitative equity market-neutral hedge funds, statistical arbitrage desks.

## Required data

Daily/intraday return matrices for a broad equity universe, rolling eigenvalue/eigenvector decompositions.

## Caveats

Factor loading structures can drift during market crises, requiring regular covariance matrix orthogonalization.
